# Text filters: cat, head, tail, sort, uniq, cut, paste, tr, nl, wc, fold,
# fmt, expand, unexpand, tac, comm, join, od, base64, base32.

cat -n a.txt b.txt
cat -A tabs crlf noeol
cat -s -b a.txt empty b.txt
cat missing a.txt
head -n 2 a.txt words
head -c 5 a.txt
head -n -1 a.txt
tail -n 1 a.txt b.txt
tail -c 4 noeol
tail -n +2 a.txt
sort words a.txt
sort -n nums
sort -g nums
sort -r -u dup
sort -t, -k2,2n csv
sort -f dup
sort -c dup
sort -k3 missing
uniq dup
uniq -c dup
uniq -d -i dup
uniq -u dup
cut -d, -f1,3 csv
cut -c2-4 a.txt
cut -f2 tabs
cut -d, -f2 --complement csv
cut -s -d: -f1 a.txt
cut -f
cut -c0 a.txt
paste a.txt b.txt
paste -s -d, a.txt
paste -d: a.txt b.txt empty
tr a-z A-Z < words
tr -d aeiou < words
tr -s ' o' < words
tr -c -d 'a-z\n' < words
tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]' < a.txt
tr a
nl a.txt
nl -ba -s': ' empty a.txt
wc a.txt b.txt
wc -l -w words
wc -c noeol
LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 wc -m bin a.txt
wc missing a.txt
fold -w 6 words
fold -s -w 10 words
fmt -w 12 words
expand tabs
expand -t 4 tabs
unexpand -a tabs
tac a.txt b.txt
comm a.txt b.txt
comm -12 a.txt b.txt
join a.txt b.txt
od -c bin
od -An -tx1 a.txt
od -x noeol
base64 a.txt
base64 -w 8 words
base64 a.txt | base64 -d
base32 b.txt
base32 -d a.txt
